params.body:
The empty place at the end of each section on Curate's front page read "Add a place". That names the layout, not what the editor adds.

## Change

- The + now says what it adds: "Add a post", "Add a trend", "Add a report".
- When nothing is left, it says "No other post to add" (or trend, or report).
- While another change is saving, the + was disabled and read "Nothing else to add", which was not true. It is still disabled while saving, but now keeps its label.

## Checked

- `npm test`: 44 of 44 pass. `npm run build` is clean.
params.title: Curate: the + says what it adds
